drops-old-label-in-final-mapping.final.yml:
route:
  receiver: fallback
  group_by:
  - case
  group_wait: 100ms
  group_interval: 200ms
  repeat_interval: 1h
  routes:
  - receiver: new_team
    matchers:
    - team="revenue"
receivers:
- name: new_team
  webhook_configs:
  - url: http://127.0.0.1:0/new_team
    send_resolved: true
- name: fallback
  webhook_configs:
  - url: http://127.0.0.1:0/fallback
    send_resolved: true
